Name: QS-0000
Description__c: Semi-join: Accounts that have at least one open Opportunity via WHERE IN subquery.
Query_Key__c: Accounts With At Least One Open Opportunity (Semi-Join)
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, Industry, Phone FROM Account WHERE Id IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false)

Name: QS-0001
Description__c: Parent-to-child: Account with its related Contacts subquery.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, Industry, (SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email FROM Contacts ORDER BY LastName) FROM Account WHERE Id = :accountId

Name: QS-0002
Description__c: Anti-join: Accounts that have no related Contacts via WHERE NOT IN subquery.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, Industry, Phone, CreatedDate FROM Account WHERE Id NOT IN (SELECT AccountId FROM Contact WHERE AccountId != null)

Name: QS-0003
Description__c: Multiple subqueries: Account with open Opportunities and open Cases.
Query_Key__c: Accounts With Open Opportunities And Cases
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, (SELECT Id, Name, StageName, Amount FROM Opportunities WHERE IsClosed = false), (SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Status FROM Cases WHERE IsClosed = false) FROM Account WHERE Id = :accountId

Name: QS-0004
Description__c: AVG, MAX, MIN of Opportunity Amount per Account with a HAVING filter.
Query_Text__c: SELECT AccountId, AVG(Amount) avgAmount, MAX(Amount) maxAmount, MIN(Amount) minAmount FROM Opportunity WHERE Amount != null GROUP BY AccountId HAVING AVG(Amount) > :minAvg

Name: QS-0005
Description__c: COUNT of Cases grouped by both Status and Priority - 2D breakdown.
Query_Key__c: Case Count By Status And Priority
Query_Text__c: SELECT Status, Priority, COUNT(Id) caseCount FROM Case GROUP BY Status, Priority ORDER BY Status, Priority

Name: QS-0006
Description__c: Child-to-parent: Case traversing Contact and Account relationships.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Subject, Status, Contact.Name, Contact.Email, Account.Name FROM Case WHERE IsClosed = false

Name: QS-0007
Description__c: Child-to-parent: Contact records traversing up to Account fields.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Account.Name, Account.Industry FROM Contact WHERE AccountId != null

Name: QS-0008
Description__c: COUNT grouped by Industry - number of Accounts per industry.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Industry, COUNT(Id) recordCount FROM Account WHERE Industry != null GROUP BY Industry ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC

Name: QS-0009
Description__c: COUNT_DISTINCT: number of unique Industry values across all Accounts.
Query_Text__c: SELECT COUNT_DISTINCT(Industry) distinctIndustries FROM Account WHERE Industry != null

Name: QS-0010
Description__c: Filters Accounts by the Industry picklist value.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, Industry, Rating FROM Account WHERE Industry = :industry

Name: QS-0011
Description__c: Returns all Account records with basic fields.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, Industry, Type, Phone FROM Account LIMIT 200

Name: QS-0012
Description__c: Filters Cases by their Status value.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Subject, Status, Priority FROM Case WHERE Status = :status

Name: QS-0013
Description__c: Open cases filtered by both Account and Contact.
Query_Key__c: Get Cases For Contact On Account
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Subject, Status, Priority, CreatedDate, Contact.Name, Contact.Email, Account.Name, Account.Industry FROM Case WHERE AccountId = :accountId AND ContactId = :contactId AND IsClosed = false ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC

Name: QS-0014
Description__c: Returns Contacts belonging to a given Account.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone FROM Contact WHERE AccountId = :accountId

Name: QS-0015
Description__c: OR compound condition - Cases that are High Priority or Escalated.
Query_Key__c: Get High Priority Or Escalated Cases
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Subject, Status, Priority, IsEscalated FROM Case WHERE Priority = 'High' OR IsEscalated = true ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC

Name: QS-0016
Description__c: Current user filter - open Tasks owned by the running user via UserInfo.getUserId().
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Subject, Status, Priority, ActivityDate, What.Name, Who.Name FROM Task WHERE OwnerId = :currentUserId AND IsClosed = false ORDER BY ActivityDate ASC

Name: QS-0017
Description__c: Returns all open Opportunities ordered by close date.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, StageName, Amount, CloseDate FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false ORDER BY CloseDate ASC

Name: QS-0018
Description__c: WITH USER_MODE enforces FLS and record sharing at the query level.
Query_Key__c: Get Open Opportunities With User Mode (FLS Enforced)
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, StageName, Amount, CloseDate, Account.Name FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false WITH USER_MODE ORDER BY CloseDate ASC

Name: QS-0019
Description__c: IN filter - Opportunities matching any stage in the provided list.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, StageName, Amount, CloseDate, Account.Name FROM Opportunity WHERE StageName IN :stageList ORDER BY Amount DESC

Name: QS-0020
Description__c: Date range filter using two bind variables for start and end date.
Query_Key__c: Get Opportunities Closing In Date Range
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, StageName, Amount, CloseDate, Account.Name FROM Opportunity WHERE CloseDate >= :startDate AND CloseDate <= :endDate ORDER BY CloseDate ASC

Name: QS-0021
Description__c: Pagination using LIMIT and OFFSET bind variables.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, Industry, Type, Phone FROM Account ORDER BY Name ASC LIMIT :pageSize OFFSET :offsetSize

Name: QS-0022
Description__c: Returns Leads modified in the last 7 days.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, Company, Status, LeadSource FROM Lead WHERE LastModifiedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:7 ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC

Name: QS-0023
Description__c: COUNT of Leads grouped by LeadSource and Status with HAVING clause.
Query_Key__c: Lead Count By Source And Status
Query_Text__c: SELECT LeadSource, Status, COUNT(Id) leadCount FROM Lead GROUP BY LeadSource, Status HAVING COUNT(Id) > 0 ORDER BY COUNT(Id) DESC

Name: QS-0024
Description__c: Monthly revenue rollup for Closed Won Opportunities this year using date functions.
Query_Key__c: Monthly Closed Won Revenue This Year
Query_Text__c: SELECT CALENDAR_MONTH(CloseDate) closeMonth, CALENDAR_YEAR(CloseDate) closeYear, SUM(Amount) totalRevenue, COUNT(Id) dealCount FROM Opportunity WHERE StageName = 'Closed Won' AND CloseDate = THIS_YEAR GROUP BY CALENDAR_MONTH(CloseDate), CALENDAR_YEAR(CloseDate) ORDER BY CALENDAR_YEAR(CloseDate), CALENDAR_MONTH(CloseDate)

Name: QS-0025
Description__c: Multi-level child-to-parent: Opportunity traversing Account and Owner.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Name, StageName, Amount, Account.Name, Account.BillingCity, Owner.Name, Owner.Email FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false

Name: QS-0026
Description__c: LIKE text search on Contact Name. Pass searchTerm as "%john%" for partial match.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, Account.Name FROM Contact WHERE Name LIKE :searchTerm ORDER BY LastName

Name: QS-0027
Description__c: Polymorphic TYPEOF: returns different fields on Task.What depending on whether it is an Account or Opportunity.
Query_Text__c: SELECT Id, Subject, Status, ActivityDate, TYPEOF What WHEN Account THEN Name, Industry WHEN Opportunity THEN Name, StageName, Amount ELSE Id END FROM Task WHERE IsClosed = false

Name: QS-0028
Description__c: SUM and COUNT of Opportunities grouped by StageName.
Query_Text__c: SELECT StageName, SUM(Amount) totalAmount, COUNT(Id) dealCount FROM Opportunity WHERE Amount != null GROUP BY StageName ORDER BY SUM(Amount) DESC
